name: Curio Tray
description: Empty a layered cabinet into a seven-slot tray without stranding unmatched curios.
natural_language: Use only screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Empty the cabinet by clicking the visible top curio. Three matching curios disappear together and free their slots; seven unmatched curios lose the attempt. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM, page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload, navigation, browser extensions, or external applications.

metadata.notes: Original layered cabinet puzzle grounded in SOC-444: exposed items are picked into seven visible tray slots, triples clear, and an unmatched full tray loses. Accessibility, browser hit testing, live grading, and exported verification share the same rectangle/z-order contract.
